editorial.note: Scholars have recently speculated that this work does not actually depict a nun, although it has been described as such since 1543.

In Northern Europe portraits were less idealized than in Italy. That is not to say that the women there were more modest. While this lady presents an unadorned face, her clothes are particularly sumptuous.
